name: o2o_quote_guard_micro_v1
description: Micro Printful quote guard for POD shipping preflight. Fast low-cost check to catch missing destination or item fields before paid fulfillment flows.

countryCode.description: Destination ISO country code (example: US, KR).

stateCode.description: Destination state/province code. Recommended for US shipments.

items.description: Optional line items for a live quote probe (variant_id + quantity).
